source: RFC 0014 §3 R1, R2, R6, T (the coordinator's ruling of 2026-11-24 on phase 2 of the cross-version fixture); the red-team inventory, row 17
statement: A control API answer is read leniently by control-sdk, a member it does not know ignored, except a document's entries, read strictly so that applying back what was read never drops a member (CTL-76): an answer either version's control plane gives, either version's client reads alike.
guards: compat:ControlApiCompatTest#an answer either version's control plane gives, either version's client reads alike, ignoring a later member
compat:ControlApiCompatTest#a document's entries in an answer are read strictly by every client
